verdict.rationale: Retention and deletion controls are a fair question for an incident-management SaaS that stores incident data, call transcripts and AI-generated content, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains no documentation of configurable retention periods, data deletion, or purge controls. Private incidents and audit logs cover access and change tracking, which are adjacent features and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
